subject: EN
prompt: **17.** Why do many people volunteer in poor countries?

choices: to make themselves feel good
as part of their school programme
to have a cheap holiday
to improve their language skills

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 1: *hoping to do good … All seek personal growth, connection to those less fortunate, and the satisfaction of making a difference.*
Teile den Artikel in Abschnitte ein, markiere die Schlüsselwörter der Frage und suche sie im passenden Abschnitt.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 17

subject: EN
prompt: **18.** According to Pippa Biddle the term 'voluntourism' refers to …

choices: people paying to do volunteer work abroad.
trips to eco holiday resorts.
volunteers doing social work in their own communities.
all-inclusive club holidays.

solution.correct_choice: people paying to do volunteer work abroad.

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 2: *travellers … wanted a more authentic experience – and they were willing to pay for it.*

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 18

subject: EN

choices: to avoid having to pay local workers.
to benefit from their expert knowledge.
to make them feel good.
to break down cultural barriers.

solution.correct_choice: to avoid having to pay local workers.

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 3: *if a charity hired locals for its unskilled work, it would be spending money. If it uses volunteers who pay to be there, it's raising money.*

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 19

subject: EN
prompt: **20.** Locals should do the work instead of volunteers because …

choices: locals are looking for paid work.
labour done by locals is cheaper.
people benefit when they can help themselves.
both A + C

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 4: *People are desperate for jobs* (A) **und** *long-term change happens when people can solve their own problems* (C). Bei *both A + C* müssen beide Aussagen belegt sein, und das sind sie hier.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 20

subject: EN

choices: had difficulties coping with the heat.
were sent home because of their bad work.
caused more work rather than less.
had to work day and night.

solution.correct_choice: caused more work rather than less.

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 5: *each night the men had to take down the structurally unsound bricks we had laid and rebuild the structure*.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 21

subject: EN

choices: brings people together to make a difference.
can lead to mental health problems.
has a lasting positive effect on communities.
is too ineffective to be useful.

solution.correct_choice: is too ineffective to be useful.

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 6: *this work hadn't made better people out of the volunteers*, und die Häuser kosteten das 15-Fache.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 22

subject: EN
prompt: **23.** What does the author criticize about the organisation Hope of Life?

choices: They care more for the volunteers than the needy.
They employ the wrong people.
They limit the number of volunteers in certain areas.
They recruit too many volunteers in the summer months.

solution.correct_choice: They care more for the volunteers than the needy.

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 7: *not much money was being spent on its weakest, disabled residents, while a lot of investment has gone towards making the volunteer experience as comfortable as possible*.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 23

subject: EN
prompt: **24.** McGehee thinks that travelling abroad should lead to …

choices: higher prices of flights.
a change of your lifestyle.
a better image of Western tourists.
both A + B

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 8: *go home and see if there's something you're doing that somehow contributes to their problems* → das eigene Verhalten ändern. Von Flugpreisen ist nicht die Rede.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 24

subject: EN
prompt: **25.** Another title for this article could be …

choices: Do Western do-gooders actually do harm?
How volunteer work makes the world a better place
Want to get rich? Start a volunteer organization
Stop travelling – reduce your carbon footprint!

solution.correct_choice: Do Western do-gooders actually do harm?

explanation.title: Beleg im Text
explanation.body: Abschnitt 1: *the booming business of "voluntourism" supports practices and institutions that actually do harm.* Der ganze Artikel begründet diese These.

source: MSA Berlin 2024 Englisch, Reading Part 3, Nr. 25
